title: How to Convert Your ZX Bank Savings Account to a Salary Account

nodes.title: Why Convert to a Salary Account?
nodes.summary: Salary account benefits include zero minimum balance in most types, faster salary credit and alerts, preferential offers on loans and credit cards, fee waivers on select services, and exclusive benefits like insurance and accidental coverage.

nodes.title: Steps to Convert Savings Account to Salary Account at ZX Bank
nodes.summary: Six steps: verify employer tie-up, visit the home branch or use the ZX Bank Asia app, provide required documents, fill the conversion form, get documents verified and processed, then enjoy salary account benefits.

children.title: 1. Check Your Employer's Tie-Up
children.summary: Confirm with your HR or Payroll department whether they have a salary account arrangement with ZX Bank, and obtain the official employer letter or introduction.

children.title: 2. Visit Your Home Branch or Use ZX Bank Asia App
children.summary: Initiate the conversion by visiting your ZX Bank home branch or through the 'Account Services' section of the ZX Bank Asia app.

children.title: 3. Provide Required Documents
children.summary: Prepare employee ID card, an employer letter on company letterhead (employment status, salary account introduction, and account number for upgrades), PAN card if not on file, a passport-size photograph if required, and a KYC update if asked.

children.title: 4. Fill Out Conversion Form
children.summary: At a branch, ask for the Account Conversion/Upgrade Form; on the app, navigate to menu > Account Services > Convert to Salary Account, follow prompts, and upload scanned documents if prompted.

children.title: 5. Verification and Processing
children.summary: The bank verifies the documents and, upon success, changes your account type to a Salary Account; obtain written or email confirmation from the bank.

children.title: 6. Enjoy Salary Account Benefits!
children.summary: Once converted you get zero minimum balance, priority services and offers, and employer-specific benefits where applicable.

nodes.title: Frequently Asked Questions
nodes.summary: Answers FAQs: account number and debit card stay the same (unless you opt for a premium variant); no salary credits for 3-6 months can revert the account to a regular savings account with minimum balance criteria; online conversion works when your employer is registered and KYC is current.

children.title: Q: Will my account number or debit card change?
children.summary: No — your account number remains the same; a debit card change happens only if you opt for exclusive salary account variants.

children.title: Q: What if my salary is not credited for a few months?
children.summary: If salary isn't credited for 3-6 months (per bank policy), the account may revert to a regular savings account with applicable minimum balance criteria.

children.title: Q: Can I convert online?
children.summary: Yes — if your employer is registered with ZX Bank and your KYC is up to date, you can convert via the ZX Bank Asia app or NetBanking.
